expectations.evidence: RIGHT PARAGRAPH, DIFFERENT REASON. The record on 94-99 rules only on an exclusivity word: "CLAIM       false: \"which is the one failure a galley must not produce quietly\" / true: \"which is one of the two failures this file refuses over rather than splicing\"" (findings.md:96), with REASON "An exclusivity claim, and it is refuted inside its own file. Two conditions stop a file before anything is written -- a stale range, and two edits over one line" (findings.md:97-99). Nothing in the record, and nothing in the CODE CONCERNS section (findings.md:272-278, which raises only mixed line endings and the stale/clash reporting order), names raw_lines, the census-stored form of a docstring, or the AST value lacking quote delimiters and first-line indent. The arm in fact ENDORSED the mechanism: on BLOCK 172 it emitted `clean` reasoning "`raw_lines` is the only stored copy of the file as the reviewers read it, read by `block_matches` and by nothing else here; and the staleness check ... compares the file against that stored copy rather than against itself" (findings.md:246-250) -- i.e. it examined the exact comparison the answer key faults and certified it.
